spoken_summary: An interviewer asks Mark Zandi, the chief economist from Moody's Analytics, what the Inflation Reduction Act will do for inflation. Zandi explains that it will lower prescription drug, health insurance, and energy costs. He states, "So net-net, it will push inflation lower." He also adds that the bill will reduce carbon emissions, providing long-term economic benefits.
